label: For any claim type, world type and interpretation with truth-functional negation: if a worldview…
paraphrase: For any claim type, world type and interpretation with truth-functional negation: if a worldview entails the negation of a specified duty-content, the worldview is not jointly satisfiable with that content; if it also explicitly accepts the duty-content, it is internally inconsistent; if the duty-content is true at an actual world, the worldview cannot be satisfied there. Joint compatibility with a content is preserved under all semantic consequences of that content. The first and third clauses alone do not establish internal contradiction, objective duty, or a normative ought.
